script_text: Brace yourself, Aquarius—Uranus is flipping the switch on your breakthroughs today, energizing your Air element with fresh ideas. Watch for impulsive fights under the Mars–Uranus square and choose calm dialogue to keep harmony. Avoid rash decisions under the Mars–Uranus square—they can backfire; channel Jupiter’s optimism into teamwork for lasting gain. Follow for tomorrow’s reading and stay tuned for the cosmic upgrades coming this week.
